title: Beats: the time a model composes (rise.current.v2)
acceptance: A rise.current.v2 Current (beats over scenes: say, hold, show; scene, cue, transition, place, size, type, emphasis, sound) is validated with a code and a path, lowered onto the Experience Program (movement, visual, audio tracks), and compiled so a hold is one silent atom of its own duration and a shown beat's atoms share theirs; unit-tested.

In the card the sealed Current is compiled whole; the stream carries the spoken beats; the voice is given only what is spoken; a beat conductor ahead of the speech governor times holds and shown beats; unit-tested at the runtime.
The Worker admits v2 beside v1: the tool's schema is the oneOf of both, the guide carries a v2 example and rules; unit-tested.
In the self-contained card a v2 reading plays a hold and a shown line and the voice goes on after (browser test).
Owner witnesses a v2 reading in Claude: a hold with the scene playing, a shown line, speech after.

evidence.note: The Creative Control design; §5 the Current v2, §6 its compilation, §7 the runtime. Approved by the owner 2026-10-08.

activity.summary: Opened from the approved design; built directly against it at the owner's instruction (no per-piece plan).

summary: The first Creative Control sub-project: a Current of beats over scenes, compiled onto the existing score, timed by a conductor beside the voice. Native scenes without parameters; typography, manifests and generated scenes follow in CC-003..005.
